mismatches.question: Can I switch my health insurer and keep my accumulated waiting-period credit for pre-existing diseases?
mismatches.rationale: Reg 18 (p.27) mandates portability credit for PED waiting periods.

mismatches.question: Do all health insurers have to use the same standard definitions for terms in my policy?
mismatches.rationale: Reg 20 (p.12) mandates standard definitions across insurers.
